description: A new pool house and associated garden works, creating a stylish leisure space for a home near Colchester.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: The owners of Spindle Hill, Hadleigh Road, Higham, asked Architecture ONE to design a new pool house for the garden, in a setting within the Dedham Vale Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: Architecture ONE designed a standalone pool house building, with elevations and a block plan prepared to suit the AONB landscape setting.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Babergh District Council granted full planning permission for the pool house in December 2018 (application ref. DC/18/04864).

note: Address refined to include 'Hadleigh Road', as shown on the planning decision notice.
